classification_legend.A: canonical customer identity -- convert to uuid, add FK to profiles(id)
classification_legend.B: tenant identity -- convert to uuid, add FK (tenant is 1:1 with customer in this product)
classification_legend.C: external provider identifier -- LEAVE ALONE, converting destroys the link to the provider
classification_legend.D: arbitrary text or a reference to a non-customer table -- leave alone
classification_legend.E: legacy identifier requiring data migration -- values are not UUID-shaped, so conversion is BLOCKED until they are reconciled
classification_legend.UNCLASSIFIED: no rule placed it; excluded from conversion. Not a synonym for safe.

convertibility_caveat: A column whose table is EMPTY reports zero non-convertible values, which is vacuously true and establishes nothing about any other database. 12 of the columns needing conversion are in that position here. The migration re-runs the same inventory against whatever database it is applied to and RAISES there, with a count and a sample, rather than trusting this result.
